item.title: Maria Ygnacio Bike Path Closed at U.S. Highway 101
item.description: (SANTA BARBARA, Calif.) – Due to recent storm damage, Santa Barbara County Public Works is closing the Maria Ygnacio Bike Path at the U.S. 101 undercrossing (from Calle Real to Lassen Drive).
